comparison.objective: Perform two cycles of two-rescuer CPR with 30 compressions and 2 breaths per cycle; candidate removes four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed repetitive compliant compression and ventilation coordination versus precision tool stabilization, discrete impact fracture, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Correct CPR sequence and counts versus four notch fractures with no damage, displacement, or fragment loss.
comparison.reason: Repeated force application is generic; CPR tests compliant cyclic actuation and sequencing, not localized fracture of a retained feature. No spec versions, depth, rate, or breath thresholds are supplied.
